notes.title: Patch - Dec 13, 2021
notes.content:
Updated features and fixes.

[list]
[*] Fixed various textures in Desert maps.
[*] Fixed materials in Fairytale Land maps.
[*] Added dynamic crosshairs.
[*] Added third-person camera perspective.
[*] Increased damage / range / rate of fire for Mas-12 shotgun.
[*] Increased damage / ammo capacity for AK-47 machinegun.
[*] Tested on Windows 11.
[/list]
